reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the preferred position for this rule is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer, so a finding of 'no covenant present' is the correct classification rather than 'missing'.

The cited paragraph (§ 14.8 Personnel) deals only with supervision, direction, assignment and subcontracting of each party's personnel and contains no solicitation, hiring or inducement restraint, supporting the rationale.
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding retained as internal evidence.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are vacuous here because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not undercut the compliance conclusion.
